text: もう　ポケモンが　ないや

patterns.name: もう〜ない
patterns.span: もう　ポケモンが　ない
patterns.explanation: もう together with ない means 'not any more'. もう　ポケモンが　ない = 'there are no Pokémon left'.

patterns.name: 〜や
patterns.explanation: や at the end of a sentence is casual talk to yourself, like a light sigh. ないや = 'there are none, oh well'.
